faq.q: Can one side photo make both a listing still and a walking clip?
faq.a: Yes. A clear side view can become a white-background still and a short on-foot clip. Keep the toe, heel, opening, and sole edge in frame so the pair stays easy to recognize.

faq.q: How do I get a sole or heel view?
faq.a: Use a separate photo of the sole or the heel. A side photo cannot reveal a sole pattern that was never in the file.

faq.q: Can I make an Amazon main image this way?
faq.a: Yes. For a main image, show the shoe alone on pure white and let it fill most of the frame. Leave out extra objects and any text on the picture. Put size and width notes in the gallery or the listing text.

faq.q: What happens if I ask for a logo I do not own?
faq.a: A logo or brand mark you do not own can be refused. If you resell branded pairs, use your own straight product photos for those listings.
Start with one full side view, then a top view and a sole or heel shot. Those three show the shape and the sole pattern a shopper checks.

faq.q: How do I keep a plain pair from looking like a known brand?
faq.a: Start from a plain pair and check the result for stripes, sole shapes, or stitching that copy a known logo. Keep marks you do not own out of the source photo and the finished scene.

faq.q: Can the clips run as paid shoe ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark, so a paid ad is fine. You can post the clip on TikTok or Meta, or download it and publish it yourself.

faq.q: How long can a shoe clip be, and what does it cost?
faq.a: You can pick 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Frame choices are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. Those lengths cost 24, 40, 60, and 120 credits. A failed clip sends its credits back. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300 credits. Premium is $63 for 600 credits. A product still costs 24 credits.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link and make more than one version?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page, or send the link from your shop software. Ask for a step in one version and a white-background side view in the other.
